options: I see the importance of personal integrity

thematic_summaries.title: Priestly Accountability
thematic_summaries.summary: God holds religious leaders to a high standard of spiritual integrity and moral conduct. The priests of Israel had corrupted their sacred calling by failing to honor God's covenant and misrepresenting divine standards.

thematic_summaries.title: Marriage and Covenant Faithfulness
thematic_summaries.summary: God emphasizes the sanctity of marriage as a divine covenant, condemning unfaithfulness and divorce. The chapter reveals God's deep concern for marital commitment and spiritual unity between spouses.

reevaluation.question: How should spiritual leadership interpret divine accountability?
options: Leaders are measured by their moral integrity, not just ceremonial performance
Spiritual authority requires consistent alignment with God's covenant principles
Institutional religious roles do not exempt leaders from personal spiritual responsibility
Genuine spiritual leadership prioritizes God's glory over personal reputation

exchange.who: The LORD of Hosts charges the priests
exchange.speaker: The LORD of Hosts

puzzle.question: Put yourself in the place of the priests hearing this. You hear that the covenant with Levi was one of life and peace, and that he revered the LORD, and then you hear that you have departed from the way and caused many to stumble. What do you weigh?

chain.summary: The LORD has been a witness between the people and the wife of their youth, against whom they have broken faith (v. 14), and He asks whether He has not made them one (v. 15). Genesis 2:24 says a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and they will become one flesh.
chain.question: How does Genesis 2:24 help you understand what it means that the LORD made husband and wife one in Malachi 2:15?

conviction.because: the LORD, the God of Israel, hates divorce
conviction.step: keep one promise I have made
conviction.template: from today I let go of my {feeling:selfishness, neglect} over {object:my closest relationships} and instead of {behavior:breaking faith in small ways}, I will {step:keep one promise I have made}.
